description: Use this module to add or remove hosts to a stacki front-end using API.

parameters.name: appliance
parameters.description: Appliance to be used in host creation. Required if state=present and host does not yet exist. Default: "backend"

parameters.name: force_install
parameters.description: Set value to true to force node into install state if it already exists in stacki. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the host to be added to Stacki.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Network to be configured in the host. Currently not used by the module. Default: "private"

parameters.name: prim_intf
parameters.description: Name of the primary network interface. Currently not used by the module.

parameters.name: prim_intf_ip
parameters.description: IP Address for the primary network interface. Currently not used by the module.

parameters.name: prim_intf_mac
parameters.description: MAC Address for the primary PXE boot network interface. Currently not used by the module.

parameters.name: rack
parameters.description: Rack to be used in host creation. Required if state=present and host does not yet exist. Default: 0

parameters.name: rank
parameters.description: Rank to be used in host creation. In Stacki terminology, the rank is the position of the machine in a rack. Required if state=present and host does not yet exist. Default: 0

parameters.name: stacki_endpoint
parameters.description: URL for the Stacki API Endpoint.

parameters.name: stacki_password
parameters.description: Password for authenticating with Stacki API, but if not specified, the environment variable stacki_password is used instead.

parameters.name: stacki_user
parameters.description: Username for authenticating with Stacki API, but if not specified, the environment variable stacki_user is used instead.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Set value to the desired state for the specified host. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

examples:
- name: Add a host named test-1
  community.general.stacki_host:
    name: test-1
    stacki_user: usr
    stacki_password: pwd
    stacki_endpoint: url
    prim_intf_mac: mac_addr
    prim_intf_ip: x.x.x.x
    prim_intf: eth0

- name: Remove a host named test-1
  community.general.stacki_host:
    name: test-1
    stacki_user: usr
    stacki_password: pwd
    stacki_endpoint: url
    state: absent
